sidebar.title: Mock servers
sidebar.none: No mock servers: create one with +. A mock answers on a local port with predefined responses and logs every call.
empty: Select a mock server in the sidebar or create a new one
routes.hint: The first matching route in list order answers (↑ ↓ to change it). Changes apply at once, also while the mock is running. A call without a route gets a 404.
routes.none: No routes: every call gets a 404 and shows up in the log.
calls.noneStopped: No calls: start the mock to receive some.
calls.select: Select a call to see its details.
mockDlg.name: Name
mockDlg.nameRequired: Enter the name of the mock
mockDlg.portHint: Listening on 127.0.0.1 only. If the mock is running, changing the port restarts it.
mockDlg.corsHint: Adds the Access-Control-Allow-* headers and answers preflight OPTIONS requests by itself, so a frontend on another port can call the mock.
